title: Free Business Tools: Calculators and Brief Builder
description: Free tools for business owners and professionals: compare in-house vs outsourcing costs, build a project brief, and work out an hourly or day rate.
h1: Free tools for smarter outsourcing decisions
intro: Quick, private tools that help you decide, brief and price. Everything runs in your browser: nothing you type is sent to us or stored.

image.alt: Calculator on a table next to a laptop

sections.html: The hardest part of outsourcing is usually the start: deciding whether to hire or buy in, then explaining what you need clearly enough to get comparable quotes. These tools help with both. For professionals, the rate calculator turns income goals into a clear minimum price.

cardText: Cost calculator, project brief builder and rate calculator. Free, no sign-up.
